currentFactorStudy.split: Dates are split chronologically and V8.7.3 purges train dates whose D+N outcomes overlap first holdout date.
currentFactorStudy.factorBucket: Within each train/holdout subset, all stock rows are globally sorted by factor x; bottom/top thirds are selected across dates.
currentFactorStudy.outcomeAggregation: Mean y across stock rows in each third.
currentFactorStudy.dateWeighting: Implicitly proportional to number of selected factor-observed rows from each date.

dateA.factorLevel: all relatively high due market-wide regime shift

fixedSyntheticWitness.issue: A global cross-date factor sort can make factor level proxy date/regime and gives date A six times row weight.
fixedSyntheticWitness.independentUnitRule: scanDate is the declared primary inference unit.

confounds: Variable selected count by date changes date weight.
Market/regime shifts in factor levels can create cross-date high/low separation unrelated to within-date stock ranking.
Selected-only truncation further conditions factor distributions.

preferredSuccessor.name: SELECTED_WITHIN_DATE_FACTOR_RANKING_V1_1
preregistration: Within each clean scanDate, compute factor percentile/rank only among eligible selected rows with the factor.
Primary date statistic compares within-date high vs low only where minimum within-date support is preregistered.
Aggregate date-level effects with equal date weight.
Report coverage loss explicitly; do not fabricate a contrast on dates with too few selected names.
Secondary pooled-row view may remain descriptive.
preferredSuccessor.limitation: Because Formal selects at most six rows, within-selected per-date ranking can be data-thin. If support is insufficient, do not lower minimums post hoc; move ranking validation to full qualified pool receipts.
